note: Written incrementally as constraints were discovered, not reconstructed at run end. Severity is the constraint's effect on what this program may claim, not on whether the run could finish.

constraints.title: Agent self-transcription is not an admissible capture method for the run prompt digest
constraints.statement: A prompt digest computed over bytes the agent transcribed from its own context authenticates the transcription and nothing upstream of it. Run provenance requires an operator-side or harness-side artifact captured independently of the agent.

evidence.authoritativeFile: operator artifact RUN-20260807-1-PROMPT.txt, digest computed before the session began
evidence.delta: one hunk at line 457; U+201C/U+201D (e2 80 9c / e2 80 9d) normalised to U+0022 (0x22); 2 characters, 4 bytes

constraints.whyItGeneralises: The failure is not the four bytes. It is that the agent's transcription was internally consistent and self-digesting while being wrong, and no amount of re-reading it from inside the agent's own context could have revealed that. Detection required a second, causally independent capture with an earlier timestamp. This is the program's own thesis turned on its own provenance: self-consistency is not fidelity, agreement with oneself is not independence, and treating a transcription's digest as the original's digest is the provenance equivalent of counting a copy as an independent evidence root.
constraints.scope: Applies to every agent-populated provenance field in every run of this program, not only to the prompt: model version, tool versions, timestamps, and any value the agent reports about its own execution context share the property that the agent cannot verify them from inside that context.
constraints.remediation: run-manifest.json must carry promptCaptureMethod with value 'operator-file' or 'harness-capture'. The value 'agent-transcription' marks the digest as unverified and any run relying on it as provenance-incomplete. The durable fix is the runtime harness writing delivered prompt bytes to disk before the agent starts.
constraints.affectsConclusionsReason: No KL-000 conclusion derives from the prompt text. KL-000 is reproducible from the committed evaluator, generator, frozen seed, and declared bounds.

constraints.title: A deleted git remote leaves surviving tracking refs that resolve cleanly, making a cache indistinguishable from the remote it once mirrored
constraints.statement: When a remote is removed from a clone, its refs/remotes/<name>/* entries can survive. Every ordinary read then succeeds against stale data: the ref resolves, git branch -r lists it, git log shows commits, and a file-presence check returns a plausible count. No error, no warning, and no output field distinguishes 'this is the remote' from 'this is what the remote looked like before it was deleted'.

evidence.mechanism: the github remote had been deleted from this clone while five refs/remotes/github/* entries survived
evidence.staleResolution: github/main resolved cleanly to 7a56663, two commits behind the true 335b34e
evidence.silentWrongAnswer: a file-presence check against the stale ref returned 8/11 with no error and no warning; the true value was 11/11
evidence.propagation: the wrong figure was written into the run prompt as a verified starting condition and would have been inherited by any run that trusted it
evidence.confirmedBy: operator, independently, after git remote add github + git fetch --prune

constraints.whyHighSeverity: The failure is silent, produces a plausible answer, and survives review. It propagated from a clone's local state into a governing instruction document, and was corrected only because an operator re-measured against the live remote. Nothing in the original measurement could have revealed it from inside.
constraints.sameErrorClassNote: PROV-004 digested a transcription as though it were the original prompt; PROV-005 measured a cache as though it were the remote. Both are a derived copy silently standing in for its source, with the copy internally consistent and locally unfalsifiable. This is the exact failure KL-000's copy-invariance invariant exists to make impossible inside the evaluator, occurring twice in one run in the program's own provenance layer, where no invariant was checking. The evaluator is not the weak point; the unchecked path from reality into the evidence record is.
constraints.remediation: Treat any remote-tracking ref as a cache until the remote is confirmed configured and freshly fetched in the same operation that reads it. Report remote-derived measurements with the fetch timestamp and the configured URL, not the ref name alone. Recorded in RESEARCH-BACKLOG-v1.json as a proposed provenance check for every future run.
constraints.affectsConclusionsReason: KL-000 tests knowledge_ledger/transaction.py, which is byte-identical on both sides of the divergence. No KL-000 conclusion depends on which base was chosen.
constraints.discoveredDuring: orientation; mechanism supplied by operator mid-run

constraints.severityNote: Raised from low. Originally recorded as ordinary staleness in a prompt. The mechanism is now known to be PROV-005, a silent measurement error that propagated into a governing document, which makes this an instance of a systemic failure rather than an isolated typo.
constraints.title: Run prompt's stated repository starting conditions were measured against a deleted remote's cache
constraints.statement: The prompt asserted github/main carries 8 of 11 authoritative files and that neither main carries the program. Both were false at run time. The figures were measured against surviving remote-tracking refs after the github remote had been deleted from the clone.

evidence.githubMain: 335b34e carries 11/11 authoritative files (12/12 including the reference fixture)
evidence.staleRefExplanation: the prompt's 8/11 figure matched 7a56663 (PR #12), the stale github/main tracking ref surviving a deleted remote; see PROV-005
evidence.correctedBy: operator, independently, after restoring the remote

constraints.consequence: The prompt's stated reason for basing the PR on agent/first-transmission -- that no main carries the program -- was false. The decision to keep that base is retained for independent reasons recorded in ORIENTATION.md section 8; a correct decision reached partly through a false premise is flagged because the same premise could as easily have justified a wrong one.
constraints.remediation: Verified rather than assumed, as the prompt itself instructed. Base selection was unaffected. Prompt corrected as v3 for future runs; v2 remains authoritative for this one.

constraints.title: The agent attributed a genuine state change to its own measurement error
constraints.statement: The agent observed that no github remote was configured, later observed that one was, and concluded its first observation had been a mistake. The first observation was correct: the remote genuinely was absent, and the operator added it between the two readings. The world changed; the measurement did not err.

evidence.secondReading: git remote -v listed github; git ls-remote github succeeded
evidence.actualCause: operator ran git remote add github + git fetch --prune between the two readings
evidence.agentInference: recorded in ORIENTATION.md section 4 as a 'transient orientation error', which was itself the error

constraints.whyItMatters: Attributing a real state change to self-error silently discards a real event, and is harder to detect than an ordinary mistake because the corrected reading agrees with reality, so the incident appears resolved. An agent that reflexively distrusts its own earlier observations when they conflict with later ones will systematically erase evidence of mutation in any environment that can change underneath it.
constraints.remediation: Timestamp environment observations and treat conflicting readings as a state-change hypothesis first, measurement-error hypothesis second, until one is ruled out. ORIENTATION.md section 4 is left in place with the correction appended in section 8 rather than rewritten.

constraints.title: Base 887bd2f and github/main 335b34e have genuinely diverged in both directions
constraints.statement: Both refs advanced two commits past merge-base 1d1491e. The reference-rendering work exists only on the base; the decision-quality clarification exists only on github/main. git diff --stat touches 10 files.

baseOnlyCommits: 0a35fe1 Render the first transmission for human readers
887bd2f Hold the human rendering to its own receipt

constraints.remediation: Recorded, not rebased. Reconciling the divergence is a separate scientific question and therefore a separate PR under the one-question-per-PR rule. No rebase, squash, or history rewrite was performed against either side.

constraints.title: The prescribed PR base branch is not published on the github remote
constraints.statement: agent/first-transmission does not exist on the github remote, and base commit 887bd2f is not published there. A draft PR cannot target an unpublished base.
constraints.remediation: Publishing a base branch to a public repository is an outward-facing act this run was not explicitly asked to perform. The decision is referred to the founder in HANDOFF-v1.md with exact commands rather than taken unilaterally.
constraints.resolutionChosen: Neither base is published, so the PR is delivered by branching fresh from github/main and cherry-picking only this run's commits. This keeps one scientific question per PR: the delivered diff carries KL-000 and this run's provenance, and does not carry 0a35fe1 or 887bd2f, which are the first-transmission render and its correction and belong in their own PR.
constraints.resolutionCaveat: The run EXECUTED on base 887bd2f and the PR branch is a cherry-pick onto github/main. Both SHAs are recorded in HANDOFF-v1.md. One orientation check is base-specific and does not transfer: the byte-identity of REFERENCE-RENDERING.md, because neither that file nor render_transmission() exists on github/main. The reference RECEIPT reproduction does transfer, since knowledge_ledger/transaction.py is byte-identical on both sides. This run therefore executes its independent reproduction on a worktree based on github/main, which simultaneously demonstrates that KL-000 does not depend on the divergent commits and validates the cherry-pick target before the PR is proposed.

constraints.title: preregistration.v0.1 cannot express four of RESEARCH-METHOD's twelve required fields
constraints.statement: The schema has no key for protocolVersion, multipleTestingCorrection, environment, or humanAuthorization. A preregistration can therefore be schema-valid and fully populated while still violating RESEARCH-METHOD.md, whose completeness condition is consequently unsatisfiable under v0.1.

evidence.finding: all 12 experiments report the same 4 missing schema keys

constraints.remediation: KL-000 preregistered under minority-prophet.preregistration.v0.2, a strict superset adding exactly these four keys. v0.1 files for KL-001..KL-011 left untouched; migration proposed as its own PR.

constraints.title: All twelve experiment directories lack five of eight required entries
constraints.statement: Every KL-NNN directory is missing fixtures/, src/, tests/, results/, and REPRODUCE.md, holding only PROTOCOL.md, preregistration.json, and STATUS.json.
constraints.blocks: program-success criterion 'every kernel has at least a complete preregistration, fixture, tests, status, and exact next gate'
constraints.remediation: Closed for KL-000 by this run. KL-001..KL-011 remain at 3/8 and their STATUS.json files now name this in their next gate.

constraints.title: Registry field firstGate silently carries three different kinds of statement
constraints.statement: firstGate is a stop condition for KL-000, a decision rule for KL-001/005/008, a safety boundary for KL-004/006/009, and a promotion rule for KL-011. RESEARCH-METHOD treats stop conditions and safety boundaries as separate required fields, so firstGate can be machine-checked against neither.

evidence.consequence: the KL-000 seed copied firstGate into stopCondition and left safetyBoundary null while appearing to transcribe the registry faithfully

constraints.remediation: Not repaired. Splitting firstGate into stopCondition, decisionRule, and safetyBoundary proposed in the backlog.

constraints.title: The ten controls RESEARCH-METHOD requires everywhere have no schema field anywhere
constraints.statement: Neither EXPERIMENT-REGISTRY.json nor preregistration.v0.1 names controls. baselines is the nearest field and is empty in all twelve, but a baseline is a comparator method while a control is a world whose correct answer is known in advance. The ten mandatory controls are therefore unenforceable by machine check.
constraints.remediation: All ten implemented as named KL-000 fixtures and declared in a new controls array in preregistration v0.2. Registry and v0.1 unchanged.

constraints.title: Evaluator search vocabulary is narrower than RESEARCH-DIRECTION.md's
constraints.statement: RESEARCH-DIRECTION.md specifies locations recorded as searched, failed, unavailable, or not searched. The evaluator defines only searched and unavailable as terminal. Behaviour is safe — any other status blocks an absence conclusion — but such statuses are counted in neither the searched nor unavailable totals, so declared != searched + unavailable silently, and a reader reconciling the three numbers would judge the receipt malformed.
constraints.remediation: Preregistered as explicit KL-000 invariant I8 and tested rather than assumed. Not repaired.

constraints.title: Two fields RESEARCH-DIRECTION.md requires in the evidence ledger are absent from the receipt
constraints.statement: The receipt emits conversionsToReverse and reason but has no flipBudget, no unattributed-evidence field, and no uncertainty field.
constraints.consequence: Low for KL-000, whose invariants do not depend on them. Medium for KL-011, whose acceptance gate requires protected fields to survive crossing systems: a field the reference receipt never emits cannot be shown to survive.
constraints.remediation: Recorded as a KL-011 prerequisite in the backlog. Not repaired.

constraints.title: Phase vocabulary in RESEARCH-METHOD does not match the kernel-state ladder
constraints.statement: RESEARCH-METHOD lists eight execution phases; the run prompt's kernel ladder has nine states. seeded and preregistered have no counterpart in RESEARCH-METHOD, whose first phase 'specification' maps onto the transition between them. Every STATUS.json also records lastCompletedGate 'registry-entry', which appears in neither list.
constraints.remediation: This run uses the nine-state ladder, since STATUS.json already does. Not repaired.

constraints.title: An under-declared search space is undetectable, and the declaring party is the reporting party
constraints.statement: Absence is admissible only inside a declared finite scope, and that scope is declared by the same party reporting the evidence. An adversary who simply omits the location containing the counterexample obtains a clean absent_within_declared_scope. The receipt shows no trace: coverage reads 3/3 complete.

evidence.observation: both receipts are internally consistent, both verify their content digests, and nothing in either distinguishes them

constraints.doesNotViolate: I2. The bounded-absence invariant holds: the conclusion genuinely is bounded by the declared scope. The attack is on the declaration, which sits upstream of anything the evaluator can observe.
constraints.whyHighSeverity: This is the cheapest possible attack on the program's headline property. It requires no forgery, no copies, no compromised issuer -- only omission. It also arrives by accident whenever a ledger is partially delivered, since a truncated ledger and a dishonest one are byte-identical.
constraints.whatWouldMitigate: An externally-fixed or independently-attested search space, declared and digested BEFORE evidence collection, with the receipt binding to that prior declaration. That moves the trust boundary from the reporter to whoever fixes the scope; it does not eliminate it. Recorded in RESEARCH-BACKLOG-v1.json.
constraints.affectsConclusionsReason: KL-000 measures whether the evaluator honours a declared scope, not whether the declaration is honest. The distinction is preregistered in PROTOCOL.md and stated in the claim-discipline block.

constraints.title: One compromised issuer can mint unlimited independent roots
constraints.statement: Root identity is an unauthenticated declared string. A single compromised issuer emitting eight distinct rootIds yields eight independent supporting roots, margin 8, and conversionsToReverse 5. Copy invariance offers no protection because these are fabrications, not copies.
constraints.relationToPublicClaims: This is the quantified cost of the boundary PUBLIC-CLAIMS.md already states: 'Root identity is operationally assigned, not semantically proved.' The red-team measures the size of that gap rather than restating it.

constraints.title: Side-conflict rejection is a single-record denial-of-service surface
constraints.statement: One appended record carrying an existing rootId with the opposite side makes the entire transaction unevaluable rather than isolating the contradiction. An adversary able to append one record can suppress an otherwise valid conclusion.
constraints.tradeoff: Fail-closed is correct for truth: no wrong answer is produced. It is not free for availability, and silence can be the adversary's objective. Governing principle 8 says uncertainty causes abstention; this is an adversary manufacturing abstention on demand.

constraints.title: Root identity is byte identity; no normalisation is specified
constraints.statement: Root ids differing by a trailing space, letter case, a fullwidth digit, or a zero-width space are distinct roots. What a human reader would call one source can be split into many without forgery.
constraints.note: This is A08's attack made deniable: the same effect as minting roots, achievable by whitespace, and plausibly explained as a data-entry inconsistency.

constraints.title: Shared upstream dependency between distinct roots is not representable
constraints.statement: Schema v0.1 has no dependency edge between roots. Two roots secretly derived from one upstream source count as two independent roots. Collapsing them is the transaction author's responsibility and nothing verifies that they did.
constraints.consequence: RESEARCH-METHOD.md requires a 'copied or shared-dependency condition' as a mandatory control. C07 covers the copied half. The shared-dependency half is untestable under v0.1 and is recorded as such rather than silently counted as covered.

constraints.title: No issuer authentication exists, so forged or replayed root receipts are indistinguishable from genuine ones
constraints.statement: v0.1 has no signature, issuer, or attestation field. A replayed or invented root receipt evaluates identically to a genuine one.
constraints.note: Adding identity would authenticate an issuer and still not prove causal independence, per governing principle 5. Authentication is a prerequisite for attributing a root, not a substitute for establishing that roots are independent.

constraints.title: The claim proposition is free text and is never checked against the ledgers
constraints.statement: A receipt may assert 'No defect exists anywhere in the world' while its search ledger declares one file. The evaluator binds its conclusion to the ledgers, not to the sentence a human will read.

evidence.observed: declared 1, searched 1, complete -> absent_within_declared_scope under an unbounded-sounding proposition

constraints.consequence: Relevant to KL-011 presentation stage and to any human-readable rendering: the machine conclusion is correctly bounded while the prose beside it may not be. The reference rendering is generated from receipt values for exactly this reason.

constraints.title: Shell word-splitting produced a false negative during orientation
constraints.statement: A zsh loop over an unquoted string variable did not word-split, so a file-presence check reported 0/12 authoritative files present on every ref including HEAD, contradicting a directory listing taken seconds earlier.

evidence.cause: zsh does not word-split unquoted parameter expansions as bash does
evidence.detectedBy: the result contradicting an already-observed fact rather than by any check

constraints.whyRecorded: A tooling artifact that produces a uniform, plausible, wrong answer is indistinguishable from a real finding unless something independent contradicts it. The same class of error in a result-producing script would have been reported as evidence.
constraints.remediation: All multi-item shell iteration in this run uses explicit arrays. Result-bearing computation is in committed Python, not shell.
